intro: Dashel Stonefist is a notorious dwarven brawler found loitering among the shaded alleys of Old Town in Stormwind City. Nicknamed "Fist" for his quick temper and heavy hands, he is a familiar fixture of the city's rougher underbelly. Beneath his thuggish exterior, he maintains quietly dangerous connections that draw the eye of covert investigators.

p: Tucked away in the narrow, cobblestone backstreets of Old Town, Dashel Stonefist looks like any other drunken, combative dwarf looking for an excuse to throw a punch. Locals and city guards know him simply as "Fist," a moniker earned through countless street fights and scuffles outside tavern doors. Yet Dashel is far more than a simple tavern brawler; his presence in Old Town puts him right at the nexus of Stormwind's underworld, where smugglers, cutpurses, and political agitators exchange coin and rumors away from the prying eyes of Cathedral Square.
